methods.label: Recognize a certain event
methods.explanation: A score no greater than 6 is a certain event. All 6 outcomes satisfy the condition, so the probability is \(6/6=1\).
methods.levelReason: Uses recognition of certainty and a simple favorable-outcome ratio.
